description: Finite same-topology AS2/Piper-H target-aware pretraining research assumptions. Official EDU ~20 kg and Piper-H brochure 2 kg payload are context only; endpoints are not calibrated or guaranteed hardware limits. No new task, action or observation semantics.

variants.name: nominal
variants.assumption: Source nominal, not identified AS2 EDU hardware.

variants.name: base_density_110
variants.assumption: Research assumption: base density +10% at unchanged geometry, not allocation of the source-vs-EDU mass difference.

variants.name: legs_095
variants.assumption: Research assumption: all four leg segments isotropically scaled 0.95 at constant density; nominal angles unchanged.

variants.name: legs_105
variants.assumption: Research assumption: all four leg segments isotropically scaled 1.05 at constant density; nominal angles unchanged.

variants.name: arm_density_110
variants.assumption: Research assumption: each physical Piper link density +10%, including gripper, not hardware calibration.

variants.name: tcp_point_1kg
variants.assumption: Research probe: 1 kg point mass at nominal TCP; no payload collision geometry, grasp or rated full-extension claim.

parameter_ranges.status: Finite research endpoints for initial loading validation, not full target-domain coverage or calibration. Variables are not a Cartesian-product training distribution.

base_mass_ratio.meaning: Fixed geometry density; no allocation of missing EDU mass.

leg_scale.meaning: Hip/thigh/calf/foot isotropic scaling, constant density, fixed torso hip anchors.

piper_link_mass_ratios.meaning: All positive-mass Piper links including fixed gripper; individual ratios supplied by name.

payload_mass_kg.meaning: Point-mass probe at nominal TCP, not claimed 2kg rated full-extension load.
